newsitem.title: USA: Hutchison Whampoa debt deal may grow to $2.0 bln.
newsitem.headline: Hutchison Whampoa debt deal may grow to $2.0 bln.

text.p: Hutchison Whampoa Limited unit, Hutchison Whampoa Finance Ltd's $1.5 billion 144a multi-tranche debt offering, may be increased in size yet again, syndicate sources said on Wednesday.
The offering expected to come via the private placement market, is expected to grow to $2.0 billion from an original size of $1.0 billion, sources said.
"It wouldn't surprise me if it went higher ... it's been bumped up once already so there seems to be a lot of interest in the paper," said one syndicate official.
The A3/A-plus rated offering, which may price as early as Wednesday is expected to include the following four tranches, players said.
- 10-year price talk seen between 85-90 basis points,
- 20-year price talk seen between 100-105 basis points,
- 30-year price talk is seen between 110-115 basis points,
- 40year, putable in 12th year, seen between 82-85 basis points.
Amounts of individual tranches were not immediately available.
Merrill Lynch & Co and Goldman Sachs & Co are expected to jointly underwrite the offering.
A roadshow for the offering was held last week in Hong Kong followed by this week in New York.
